title: Gate values determined by gate relations
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to every input and gate coordinate. Suppose that at every gate its sign, interpreted as a Boolean value with $-1$ representing true, satisfies the relation prescribed by that gate and the signs of its input or earlier gates. Then at each gate, the Boolean value represented by its sign equals the value obtained by evaluating the circuit gate using the Boolean values represented by the input-coordinate signs.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on n input bits
A sign assignment to all input and gate coordinates
A gate index in the circuit
